subject: Re: Close calendar redistribution — claim, verify, or freeze

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Helen Zhou <hzhou@medvantage.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Sep 2028 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Close calendar redistribution — claim, verify, or freeze

Hi team — quick sweep on MDV-8721. Finance asked us to tidy up any deals with close dates in Q4 that haven't shown activity in 30+ days. Current snapshot shows Close Date 2028-11-30, Stage: Negotiation, ARR: $420k. No activity logged in SF in 45 days.

Can someone on our side (Vanessa/Jonas) confirm whether this is still a live commit or should be redistributed to the holdlist for the upcoming forecast freeze? If Helen/MedVantage still plan to close this quarter, please reply with the next concrete milestone (PO date, exec sign-off, contract redline) and drop any supporting docs.

I'm attaching the opportunity snapshot and a small SF extract for quick review. If I don't hear a claim by EOD Fri (9/15), we'll put this into the 'freeze/hold' queue and exclude from the Q4 committed numbers.

Thanks — short bullets please so finance can reconcile.

—Rafael
Rafael Mendes
Manager, Commercial Operations | Redwood Inference
r.mendes@redwood.com | x4607

Attachments: MedVantage_Opportunity_Snapshot.pdf (pdf); sf-opportunity-extract-8721.csv (csv)

From: Helen Zhou <hzhou@medvantage.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 13 Sep 2028 08:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Close calendar redistribution — claim, verify, or freeze

Hey Rafael — thanks for the ping and for the snapshot. MedVantage is still planning to close MDV-8721 this quarter. Current blockers: final legal review of a single clause and an internal procurement approval scheduled for 9/21.

I can confirm:
- Exec sponsor verbally approved on 9/10
- Legal expects to clear redline by 9/19
- Procurement final approval 9/21, PO expected within 48 hours after that

I'll upload the draft redline and procurement confirmation to the Drive link you shared by 9/18. Please keep it in-scope for Q4 commit — we consider this a high-priority renewal.

Thanks,
Helen

Head of Partnerships | MedVantage

Noted — pulling this into my 1:1 with the AE. Quick internal update: AE logged a customer call on 9/10 but did not update Next Step or Commit Confidence. I'll ask ACE to add a short ticket in SF and flag legal redline ETA.

Jonas — can you confirm whether we have any technical blockers outstanding (SLA matrix or deployment window) that would change the expected close date? If none, I'll mark this as 'Owner confirmed' and track Helen's uploads.

Karthik — FYI: Finance will want evidence of procurement + signed PO before treating as committed. If we get procurement note by 9/21 and PO within 48 hours, we can keep in the committed column; otherwise we freeze.

Vanessa Ortiz

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>

Thanks — quick technical check: no infra/SLA blockers on our side. Customer requested a minor configuration window in early Nov but that is scheduling only, not gating contract signature.

Rafael/Vanessa — I'll update SF: set Next Step = "Legal redline ETA 9/19; Procurement 9/21" and add a commit confidence note (70%). Helen — if you can upload the redline to the Drive link and drop a one-line confirmation when procurement is complete, that will be sufficient for Finance to keep this in the commit column.

If we don't receive procurement confirmation by 2028-09-23 18:00 PDT, Finance will move MDV-8721 to the hold/freeze list for Q4 reconciliation.
